title: NTS-KE: Extend Lookup Values
description:
* Add new IANA-assigned record type
* Change some value lookups to range_string
* Add unassigned and reserved ranges
* Changed display base to decimal
* Add warning codes

@@ -69,32 +69,54 @@ static bool nts_ke_chrony_compat_mode = false;

+    { RECORD_TYPE_UA_2_LOW, RECORD_TYPE_UA_2_HIGH, "Unassigned" },

+/* https://www.iana.org/assignments/nts/nts.xhtml#nts-error-codes */

+/* https://www.iana.org/assignments/nts/nts.xhtml#nts-warning-codes */

         },
         { &hf_nts_ke_aead_algo,
             { "AEAD Algorithm", "nts-ke.aead_algo",

NTS-KE: Extend Lookup Values

* Add new IANA-assigned record type

* Changed display base to decimal
* Add warning codes
